verdicts.reason: A: the dark header bar is shifted left and stops about 40px short of the right edge, so the brand bar visibly misaligns with the centred content. There is also a large dead gap between the eyebrow and the headline, and 'Ships late June' floats about 90px below the CTA, cut off from its button. B: the header is inset on both sides, so it doesn't bleed to the edges, but at least it is symmetric. Its vertical spacing is overstretched, with big uneven gaps around the body copy and CTA, and 'Ships late June' drifts down beside the legal text instead of sitting with the button. Both keep a legible headline wrap, but B's centred header makes it slightly less broken.
